text.tspan: “PS-” filename refers to a machine file to cut down a (4’ x 8’ full sheet) into a
printable size known as a Press Sheet (can be a custom size)
“SR-” ,“TR-” or “Run #” refers to a printed sheet to cut down a Press Sheet into its final size
ShortRun #5369 Work Order #59-308 Customer: STOCK #of Colors: 3

Metal Thickness: .040 Qty of Sheets:30 Date: 10-17-2024
